observations.action: Capture Storefront GraphQL made by widget on page load
observations.observed_result: 2 requests POST https://<MYS_STORE_DOMAIN>/api/2026-04/graphql.json (200, initiator mysbox-v1.js). Header names sent: content-type, x-shopify-storefront-access-token ([REDACTED]; same value as window._Mysbox.storefrontToken), plus browser sec-ch-* / referer / user-agent. Query 1 verbatim (whitespace collapsed): 'query getVariants($ids: [ID!]!) { nodes(ids: $ids) { id ... on ProductVariant { id title availableForSale price { amount currencyCode } image { url } product { title handle variantsCount { count precision } } } } }' with the 3 prize variant gids -> all availableForSale true, price 225000.0 VND. Query 2 verbatim: 'query getProducts($ids: [ID!]!) @inContext(language: EN, country: VN) { nodes(ids: $ids) { ...on Product { id title handle availableForSale variants(first: 250) { nodes { id title image { url } availableForSale price { amount currencyCode } metafield(namespace: "mysbox", key: "box") { value } } } } } }' with gid://shopify/Product/9429080440987 -> variant 49841673601179 availableForSale true, price 100000.0 VND, metafield: null. Neither query requests quantityAvailable (bundle contains 0 occurrences of 'quantityAvailable'). Other operations present in the bundle (not fired on this page): getProductVariantIds, getCollectionVariants, getCollectionPriceBounds, getVariantPriceBounds. No request to MYS_API_BASE, staging-api.mysbox.io or /apps/mysbox/* during product page load.
